findings.issue_text: UpdateCompatibilityCheck.java:48 and UpdateCompatibilityMetadata.java:48 call picocli.exit() during command execution, invoking System.exit(), terminating embedded/test JVMs and bypassing normal Picocli exit-code propagation

CompatibilityResult.java:34 changes the public exit-code contract by reassigning code 4 to “feature disabled” and moving “recreate required” to code 3 without a changelog or migration notice for automation users

goldens.comment: Incorrect method call for exit codes. The picocli.exit() method calls System.exit() directly, which is problematic:
Need to add changelog/release notes documenting the exit code change and migration guidance
